topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; annual POL-05 acknowledgment; sanctions procedure
Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber and product security reports from the vCISO
evidence: Audit committee minutes (4 quarters); reporting calendar

control_description: Organization chart and written designations: HIPAA security official, 524B owner, PSIRT lead, system owner
Hiring, training, and role-based training for CCC engineers and support staff
gap: No role-based training for complaint handlers; PSIRT capacity below the triage load
remediation: Role training (POAM-017); one more product security engineer (POAM-007)

control_description: Security responsibilities in job descriptions and objectives; sanctions applied
CCC asset inventory, data flow diagrams, and log sources support the controls

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies on the intranet; security reminders; incident reporting line
Customer security guide, BAAs, and service agreements state commitments; advisories to hospitals
control_owner: Director of Customer Support and Field Service
evidence: Customer security guide; BAA template; CCC service agreement
gap: Availability and confidentiality commitments not yet in the system description; BAA incident notice terms not tracked centrally
remediation: Update the system description with the 99.9% commitment and retention terms; BAA terms register (POAM-013)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk objectives and appetite approved by the CEO (P01)
SP 800-30 risk assessment annually; product risk assessments per release
Fraud risk considered: insider export of PHI, payment fraud, false advisories
gap: No detection of insider bulk export; payment change verification by email
remediation: Weekly privileged activity review (POAM-012); call-back verification (P01 R-047)

control_description: Significant changes assessed through change control, including cybersecurity impact
gap: 5 of 20 sampled changes skipped the cybersecurity impact question
remediation: Mandatory field in the change form (POAM-002)

control_description: Annual co-sourced internal audit; SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) examination; continuous posture monitoring
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported quarterly

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SSP to address risks
General IT controls over the CCC: identity, change, operations, backup

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies approved 2026-09-17; standards for configuration and logging in draft

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider with MFA; hardware keys for administrators; access broker; tenant isolation; encryption
evidence: Conditional access policies; broker logs; P07 IA-2(1) and SC-28 results
gap: Just-in-time access does not yet cover the container platform

control_description: Accounts provisioned from the HR feed after manager approval
Role-based access; removal on termination; access reviews
gap: Annual not quarterly reviews; 4 of 25 transfers kept prior roles; 9 engineers with standing all-tenant write access
remediation: Quarterly reviews and transfer automation (POAM-004); just-in-time production access (POAM-003)

control_description: Cloud data centers inherited from the provider (carve-out); campus badge access for offices where CCC administrators work
Media and device sanitization with records; data purge at hospital offboarding

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Web application firewall, denial-of-service protection, mutual TLS gateway, deny-by-default cloud firewall

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher on all interfaces; mutual TLS for devices; VPN for 31 hospitals

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on engineer endpoints; signed containers verified at deployment

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Monthly authenticated scans; image scanning; SBOM matching for CCC components
gap: Triage backlog includes 7 CCC component items older than 90 days
remediation: Clear the backlog; daily KEV automation (POAM-007)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP monitors identity, cloud, and CCC alerts 24x7
gap: No review of privileged activity or bulk exports; build pipeline and signing logs not in the SIEM
remediation: Weekly privileged review; onboard build and signing logs (POAM-012)

control_description: Events evaluated by the MSSP and the Security Manager; breach decisions by the Compliance and Privacy Officer
gap: 2 of 8 sampled incidents lacked a documented PHI decision

control_description: POL-03 and P08 runbooks approved 2026-09-17
gap: Runbooks not yet exercised; no incident metrics

control_description: Recovery from infrastructure code and point-in-time restore
gap: Recovery took 6 hours against a 2-hour target

control_description: Changes reviewed, tested, and approved in the pipeline; production deploys need a change ticket
gap: Cybersecurity impact question skipped in 5 of 20 sampled changes

control_description: BIA-based recovery objectives; cyber insurance; second region
gap: Failover does not meet the BIA RTO

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor tiers; SOC 2 reviews of Tier 1 vendors (Part B); subcontractor BAAs
gap: 2 subcontractors receive PHI without a BAA; critical software suppliers not monitored
remediation: Execute BAAs or stop PHI flows; STD-03 (POAM-014)

control_description: Capacity monitoring and autoscaling of the gateway, services, and database; quarterly capacity review
Environmental protections inherited from the provider; daily write-once backups in a second region; point-in-time recovery
evidence: Provider SOC 2; backup reports (30 of 30 days)

control_description: Recovery plan testing
gap: Failover tested once and missed the 2-hour RTO; no quarterly tests
remediation: Automated failover and quarterly tests before the observation period (POAM-009)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: PHI and other confidential data identified under POL-04; encryption; tenant isolation
gap: Classification policy is new; confidentiality commitments not yet in the system description
remediation: System description update; data owner confirmations

control_description: 24-month retention purge; data return or destruction at hospital offboarding
gap: The purge job for skin images (AI-001) has not been verified; 1 offboarded hospital's backups not confirmed destroyed
remediation: Verify purge jobs; destruction certificates for backups
